methodology.forecast: before each match date; earlier tournament dates may update Elo and form
methodology.same_day: all features frozen before any results from that date
methodology.calibration: sigmoid; base fit before holdout, never refit on holdout; B0 uses full training rates
methodology.brier: mean sum of squared class-probability errors (no division by number of classes)
methodology.selection_caveat: Backtests choose the model; no independent post-selection holdout remains
methodology.elo_reference: higher raw Elo predicts win/loss; exact equal-rating ties predict draw
methodology.judgement_k: Historical continental predecessors, Confederations Cup, CONMEBOL–UEFA and Pan American finals use 50. Nations Leagues, regional qualifiers, invitation, bilateral and non-FIFA cups use 30; every exact source name is listed in tournament_k.
